field_edits.updated_text: Five non-rib-bearing lumbar-type vertebral bodies are identified. Vertebral body heights and alignment are maintained. Mild multilevel degenerative spondylotic changes in the form of small marginal endplate osteophytes and mild endplate sclerosis, slightly more conspicuous in the lower lumbar spine. No acute fracture or significant spondylolisthesis. No acute osseous abnormality.
Intervertebral disc spaces are relatively maintained.

impression:
1. Mild multilevel degenerative spondylotic changes with small marginal endplate osteophytes and mild endplate sclerosis, more conspicuous in the lower lumbar spine.
2. Lower lumbar facet degenerative changes (facet arthropathy) most evident at L4–L5 and L5–S1.
3. No acute fracture or significant spondylolisthesis.
4. No acute osseous abnormality.
